title: Update before the 11:00 external review
context_note: Second-hand summary of an informal call with the customer's project office; nothing confirmed in writing.
content:
Brief update before the 11:00 review.

I spoke with the customer's project office. They are aware of a credentials issue and said their IT team expects to resolve it 'by end of week'. It is not clear whether that means Friday or earlier.

They also noted that their review materials already state 17 March as the go-live date and they expect us to present it as confirmed.

Separate point: it is unclear whether the TLS certificate issue mentioned by Infrastructure involves the same customer IT contact as the credentials issue. I could not confirm this on the call.

Can we align before 11:00?
